title: LP2-39: twenty proposed red-header cribs
question: Which of twenty fixed candidate words fit the three red runes under an affine substitution modulo 29?
summary: Seventeen exact-label segmentations have three runes. WHY is the sole affine fit in this list, with a = 7 and b = 7; this does not establish the plaintext.

scope.representation: Archived lower-block prefix IA C S, indices 27 5 15; twenty uppercase candidates segmented with exact stored GP labels only.
scope.procedure: Enumerate every exact-label segmentation, retain length three for all 812 affine encryption keys, and record every matching key.
scope.parameters: 20 fixed candidates; 22 segmentations; 17 three-rune segmentations; a = 1..28, b = 0..28; C = aP + b modulo 29; 13,804 candidate/key trials.
scope.exclusions: Spelling aliases, phonetic encodings, alternate rune orders, other words or ciphers, body-text scoring, statistical significance and a plaintext claim.

finding: WHY fits at a = 7, b = 7. The other sixteen length-compatible candidates do not fit any affine key. BEING has four or five runes under the stated labels.
limitations: Selected words and a three-rune target provide no independent confirmation. EI is not a stored GP label. Computational review; human review pending.
next_steps: Test any surviving fixed key against held-out text under a declared criterion. Add alternative spelling conventions or candidate lists as explicit variants.
